title: Grateful Dead Live at Civic Arena on 1973-09-24

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with mix and balance issues, but the show delivers solid performances – especially the China Cat > Rider jam, Mississippi Half‑Step and a strong second set.
ai_review.review: The remastered soundboard capture is usable yet suffers from a muddy mix, volume imbalances and occasional clipping, making the matrix source preferable in places. Musically the concert is respectable; the first set has some flat moments but highlights like “They Love Each Other,” “Big River” and the China Cat > Rider sequence shine, while the second set recovers with “Mississippi Half‑Step,” “Eyes of the World” and a lively finish.

ai_rating.rationale: The reviewer notes many strong song performances (show quality ~4) but also points out significant recording mix problems (recording quality ~2). Weighted combination yields a mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix is uneven with low volume and balance issues; clipping at the start of China Cat Sunflower; some sections sound better on matrix. Pitch correction needed for certain matrix sources.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
poor_songs: Ramble On Rose (cut and sluggish start)
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set starts warm but includes a few flat spots; second set recovers after an uneven opening, building momentum with strong mid‑set jams and ending on a high note.
